reason: An audit performed while the first training matrix was still in its early steps found the archived, pre-existing cross-decoder transfer protocol. Both SmolVLM2 and InternVL3.5 used 0.0002 and 5000 steps as their established stable comparison recipe, whereas 0.001 and 3000 steps are the Qwen3-VL recipe. The amendment prevents optimizer mismatch from being confounded with method generalization.
handling_of_started_runs: The two direct Qwen-recipe transfer processes are stopped before completion and retained under archive/aborted_direct_qwen_recipe. They are not formal results. All Qwen runs are unchanged.
